identity.description: Pipe-streaming agent: opens a live feed of papers from the brain-technology corpus. Send a topic, pick a duration (1 minute – 30 days), and receive each matching paper as a structured event (title, year, arXiv URL, keywords) in real time.

inputs.description: A topic keyword or phrase to match against the corpus (e.g. "EEG motor imagery")

outputs.description: Session summary as structured JSON (topic, streamed count, duration)

feed.description: Live paper events: { type: "paper", title, year, url, first_author, topic, keywords, at }

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning

tags.name: Research Assistant
tags.description: Answers questions with citations to a 215-paper arXiv corpus

tags.name: Pipe Streaming
tags.description: Long-lived session streaming structured paper events until the duration expires
examples: Stream papers about EEG for 5 minutes
